text:
Vikram: quick ask — can we run a targeted smoke + profiling pass for orchard-7b before we flip the feature flag tomorrow? need p50/p95 latency, steady-state tokens/s, and peak GPU mem for seq len 512 and 1024.

Jamey: can do, what's the exact model artifact id? orchard-7b has a couple of variants (fp16 / 4bit). which quantization?

Vikram: use orchard-7b:v1 (fp16) and orchard-7b-quant4:v1 for a quick compare. prefer to see both tiled and untiled exec if possible.

Lisa: for smoke, recommended batches = [1,4,8], concurrency 32 for our load gen. run with kv-cache warmup at 64 steps. also capture allocator traces (nvprof) if memory looks weird.

Marco: I can start the runs in perf lab. tagging @ops-ci to spin up a dedicated node pool (A100s) so we don't affect other canaries.

ops-ci: reassigning lab node pool... new ephemeral pool: lab-eph-2026-03-01 created (A100x2). job slot queued. :robot_face:

Marco: launching script now — running both artifacts, batch sweep, tiled vs untiled. will drop raw logs to s3://redwood-perf/orchard7b/4123456789/. command I used:
```bash
./run_perf.sh --model orchard-7b:v1 --batches 1,4,8 --seq-lens 512,1024 --concurrency 32 --tiled both --kv-warmup 64 --out s3://redwood-perf/orchard7b/4123456789/
```

Jamey: thanks. add a run with disabled batching (batch=1 + no batching) to measure single-request latency. also capture CPU steal and PCIe BW if possible.

Marco: added that. ETA ~18m for smoke + profiling. will post summary when done.

perf-bot: perf job started by Marco (job id: perf-4123456789-01). running on lab-eph-2026-03-01. collecting p50/p95, tokens_per_sec, peak_gpu_mem. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/perf/jobs/perf-4123456789-01

Lisa: quick note — for tiled vs untiled compare, check the first-token overhead. tiled usually adds ~6-10ms per request at batch=1 but improves throughput at batch>4. worth quantifying for seq 1024.

Vikram: also record model-output quality sanity (few prompts) to ensure quant4 doesn't hallucinate badly — we can run eval set of 20 prompts.

Marco: running eval set after perf sweep. will capture likelihood / basic similarity metrics.

perf-bot: perf job finished (perf-4123456789-01). summary:
- orchard-7b:v1 (fp16) seq512 batch1 concurrency32 tiled: p50=22ms p95=48ms tokens/s=2100 peak_gpu_mem=12.4GB
- orchard-7b:v1 seq1024 batch1 tiled: p50=44ms p95=96ms tokens/s=1850 peak_gpu_mem=15.8GB
- orchard-7b-quant4:v1 seq512 batch1 tiled: p50=28ms p95=65ms tokens/s=1750 peak_gpu_mem=8.2GB
- untiled runs increased p95 by ~12-18% at batch<=4; throughput fell 10-20% at larger seqs.
- single-request (no batching) added ~8ms for tiled path vs untiled baseline.
Full logs + traces: s3://redwood-perf/orchard7b/4123456789/ ; dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/perf/orchard7b/4123456789

Marco: uploaded nvprof allocator flame and kv-cache hit rates. allocator shows a brief 400MB spike around step 3 on seq1024 (fp16) — looks like transient cudaMalloc pattern.

Lisa: that spike matches earlier runs on similar models — probably warmup tiling buffer allocation. add a pre-warm step (one dummy request of seq1024) to the canary to remove that spike.

Vikram: are the quant4 quality checks green? any regression on the 20-prompt set?

Marco: ran the 20 prompts — quant4 pass rate (>=0.9 similarity threshold) = 17/20. three divergences look like formatting differences, not hallucinations. attaching a short diff file in the logs.

Jamey: ok sounds acceptable for feature flag rollout, but add a monitor to track quality via the same prompt set for first 24h post rollout.

Vikram: agree. Marco can you add the monitor and a canary policy: ramp 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with 15m windows and automatic rollback on p95 > 2x baseline or quality pass rate < 0.85?

Marco: will add that to rollout. I'll also enable the pre-warm step and pin orchard-7b:v1 for the canary.

ops-ci: canary infra ready. created route orchard/feature-x/canary with the requested rollout policy.

Vikram: amazing — thanks everyone. filing a short note in the release doc with links to perf dashboard and logs. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: closing job perf-4123456789-01.
